'''Yat-De Viedas''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] who served as a [[Commodore/Legends|commodore]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during its early [[Standard year/Legends|years]]. In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], he had a base on [[Nordra]] and fought during the [[Assault on Kamino]], under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]].
